declarations.name: FormFieldsetProgressElement
declarations.description: Enhances the outermost fieldsets in one wrapped form into a light-DOM, validated step-by-step experience. Progress is the current one-based section number out of the total; a single-section form hides progress and its labels. With no reference attributes, the full-width footer reserves equal Back/Next slots around progress and relocates authored enabled reset controls not hidden by a hidden attribute before Back. Any reference attribute preserves authored Reset placement and opts out of the default slot layout.

attributes.name: previous-ref
attributes.description: ID of a type=button previous button owned by the form.

attributes.name: next-ref
attributes.description: ID of a type=button next button owned by the form.

attributes.name: progress-ref
attributes.description: ID of an authored progress element.

attributes.name: progress-label-ref
attributes.description: ID of the progress text container. Otherwise reuse an associated label or generate one.

attributes.name: previous-label
attributes.description: Short visible Back label; supports destination-template tokens.

attributes.name: next-label
attributes.description: Short visible Next label; supports destination-template tokens.

attributes.name: progress-label
attributes.description: Visible current-step template. Supports {current}, {total}, and {legend}, using the active fieldset's legend.

attributes.name: previous-aria-label
attributes.description: Distinct Back accessible-name template; visible wording is retained. No aria-label is emitted when the name matches the visible text. Without an override, visible templates containing {legend} use native button naming.

attributes.name: next-aria-label
attributes.description: Distinct Next accessible-name template; visible wording is retained. No aria-label is emitted when the name matches the visible text. Without an override, visible templates containing {legend} use native button naming.

attributes.name: progress-aria-label
attributes.description: Optional distinct progress accessible-name template. The default uses the visible label through native association or aria-labelledby, without duplicating its text in aria-label.

attributes.name: no-validation
attributes.description: Discouraged opt-out of forward-step validation; delays error feedback until submission. Final native validation remains enabled.

members.name: form
members.description: Controlled form while ready, otherwise null.

members.name: stepIndex
members.description: Zero-based active step, reset to 0 on teardown.

members.name: refresh
members.description: Restore authored markup and reinitialize at the first step. Report setup failures through the error event.

members.name: next
members.description: Validate and advance. Return false at the boundary, before readiness, on validation failure, or when beforechange is canceled.

members.name: previous
members.description: Go back without validation; return false at the boundary, before readiness, or when beforechange is canceled.

members.name: goTo
members.description: Navigate synchronously to a zero-based step, validating sections crossed forward. Return false when beforechange is canceled. Throw RangeError for an unavailable index.

events.name: form-fieldset-progress:beforechange
events.description: Bubbling, cancelable navigation event after applicable validation and before rendering or focus changes. Detail describes the destination: stepIndex, stepCount, fieldset, and previousIndex. Cancellation returns false without navigating. Not emitted for setup, reset, invalid-field recovery, or requests for the active step.

events.name: form-fieldset-progress:ready
events.description: Bubbling event after successful setup; detail: stepIndex, stepCount, fieldset.

events.name: form-fieldset-progress:change
events.description: Bubbling event after a step changes; detail also includes previousIndex.

events.name: form-fieldset-progress:error
events.description: Bubbling setup failure event with detail.error; fallback markup is restored first.

cssProperties.name: --fieldset-progress-accent
cssProperties.description: Progress and primary navigation color; ensure contrast with HighlightText.

declarations.name: defineFormFieldsetProgress
declarations.description: Register the default tag on import. The helper is idempotent for the same class and tag; conflicting definitions throw.
